prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the Court of the Lions at the Alhambra with a pale marble floor, slender arcade columns, standard-height arched doorways and a low fountain, empty of visitors, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Chinese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper cube-shaped block, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a silver miniature anvil, a tin pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a copper miniature anvil, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single platinum necklace.
